title: [PTRun] System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException: {Desktop composition is disabled} 0x80263001
summary: Merged #42588 already adds graceful handling for this Run desktop-composition signature, and maintainers identify 0.96+ as the update boundary. The newest reproduced stack is from 0.83, not evidence that the fix regressed on a current build. Do not claim that suppressing the secondary Run error fixes the underlying system-wide black screen.

next_action.label: Check Run exception handling on 0.96 or newer
next_action.reason: Known recoverable composition loss does not produce the old Run exception dialog; unrelated fatal failures retain diagnostics.

judgment.rationale: Merged #42588 already adds graceful handling for this Run desktop-composition signature, and maintainers identify 0.96+ as the update boundary. The newest reproduced stack is from 0.83, not evidence that the fix regressed on a current build. Do not claim that suppressing the secondary Run error fixes the underlying system-wide black screen.
evidence: The issue tracks COMException 0x80263001 from DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea during desktop-composition loss.
Maintainers explain that graphics-driver failures or memory pressure can precede this error and recommend PowerToys 0.96 or newer.
The November 15 game-exit report explicitly identifies PowerToys 0.83.0.0; a maintainer again requests updating.
Verified PR #42588 is merged and extends recoverable DWM exception handling plus theme-change retry: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/42588

Current ExceptionHelper recognizes 0x80263001 and narrowly scoped STATUS_MESSAGE_LOST: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/82bd57f5d23ee19a98b0c46f42c304742a7db426/src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/Helper/ExceptionHelper.cs
The PR explicitly notes fatal render-thread failure can remain unrecoverable; review coverage is not a graphics-driver fix.

steps: 1. Verify the known 0x80263001 composition exception follows the recoverable path.

3. If the original game-exit/display transition recurs naturally on the updated build, distinguish the Run error from the preceding graphics failure.
